RoomType.rationale: KnowledgeDemonBoss.cs:11 RoomType => Boss. The sim carries no per-encounter RoomType field (Encounter dataclass, sts2_rl/monsters/base.py has none); it recovers the value from which ActRooms bucket the encounter id sits in. 'knowledge_demon' is in boss_keys only, matching Boss. The gold ladder (100-100, see guards G1) and card-rarity odds this RoomType would drive at reward time are keyed off the RUNTIME room_type argument generate_combat_rewards receives from the room/map layer, which is seam/rooms_and_map's mechanism (unaudited there as of this pass) -- this record verifies only that knowledge_demon's OWN RoomType value is faithfully reproduced by its pool placement, not how that value reaches the reward call.

CustomBgm.rationale: Audio only: CombatManager.cs is the sole non-Models reader (starts/stops the boss music track). The sim has no audio layer; grep confirms zero gameplay/RNG readers of CustomBgm anywhere in src/.

BossNodePath.rationale: Map-UI presentation only (map node icon asset path): NBossMapPoint.cs is the sole non-Models reader. The sim has no map-node rendering.

BossNodeSpineResource.rationale: KnowledgeDemonBoss.cs:17 forces this to null (no custom boss-node skeleton, use the placeholder icon at BossNodePath instead) -- a presentation-only override; NBossMapPoint.cs is the sole non-Models reader, both are rendering, not gameplay.

AllPossibleMonsters.rationale: Presentation/bestiary only: ActModel.cs:169 (AllMonsters, used for asset preload) and NBestiary.cs:194 (the Bestiary screen) are its only two readers in the whole game source. C# value here is [KnowledgeDemon] (1 element), matching GenerateMonsters' own roster exactly, so even the presentation-only claim has nothing to diverge from. The sim is headless (no bestiary, no asset preload) and has no per-encounter monster-vocabulary counterpart; that costs nothing observable.

HasCustomBackground.rationale: KnowledgeDemonBoss.cs:21 => true, selects CreateBackgroundAssetsForCustom over the act's default background (EncounterModel.cs:293-308) -- a rendering-asset choice consumed only by GetBackgroundAssets/GetAssetPaths (preload paths). The dedicated background Rng it threads through is NCombatRoom.GenerateBackgroundRngForCurrentPoint's own stream, not a gameplay stream, and the sim has no scene/background renderer to select between.

GetCameraScaling.rationale: Camera-only: NCombatRoom.cs is the sole non-Models reader (0.85f zoom for the boss room). No sim camera exists.

GetCameraOffset.rationale: Camera-only: NCombatRoom.cs is the sole non-Models reader (Vector2.Down * 70f). No sim camera exists.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: KnowledgeDemonBoss.cs:33-36 returns a fixed single-element list, (KnowledgeDemon, null) -- roster {KnowledgeDemon}x1, slot null, ZERO Rng draws (the ReadOnlySingleElementList wrapper takes no random input). Encounter.create_monsters (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py) for a plain Encounter with monster_slots=() builds [KnowledgeDemon(hooks, rng)] and never touches rng for selection -- roster, order (trivial, 1 element) and draw count (0) all match. Slot: zip(monsters, ()) assigns nothing, leaving slot_name=None, which matches C#'s null.

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: EncounterModel.cs:39 => false (the encounter itself is not a hook listener). combat.py builds self.enemies from encounter.create_monsters but never calls hooks.register(self.encounter) or registers the Encounter object anywhere (grep -rn 'register(.*encounter' sts2_rl/ -- no matches); only the created Monster instances register themselves (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py). The sim's Encounter is architecturally incapable of receiving hook dispatch, matching the C# default with no override needed.

guards.rationale: KnowledgeDemonBoss does not override Min/MaxGoldReward, so it inherits EncounterModel.cs:83-100's ladder: Boss => (100, 100). sts2_rl/rewards.py GOLD_REWARD_RANGES[RoomType.BOSS] = (100, 100) -- exact match, confirmed by `py audit/tools/encounter_probes_e4.py gold-ladder`. Poverty-ascension multiplier is out of scope per PROMPT.md ('Ascension values: out of scope'); rewards.py states the sim applies non-ascension values only.

Not overridden in C# (EncounterModel.cs:62 default true). KNOWLEDGE_DEMON_BOSS is constructed with no should_give_rewards= argument, so it keeps Encounter's own default True (sts2_rl/monsters/base.py).

Not overridden (EncounterModel.cs:56 default false). 'knowledge_demon' is absent from every ActRooms.weak_keys tuple (rooms.py) and present only in hive's boss_keys -- the sim never treats it as a weak-tier encounter.

GenerateMonsters draws ZERO values on either side for this unit (see GenerateMonsters hook), so there is no draw here whose stream identity could be misattributed to a shared/run-level RNG. Stream IDENTITY -- how the per-encounter Rng itself is seeded and whether the sim's construction-time random.Random() argument to Monster.__init__ is truly independent of the run's centralized stream -- belongs to seam/rng_streams per the batch brief and is not re-derived here.
